newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Grounded Torres Strait vessel refloat seen Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Grounded Torres Strait vessel refloat seen Tuesday.

text.p: Attempts to refloat a 47,000-tonne bulk coal carrier aground in Torres Strait, north of the Australian state of Queensland, could be made on Tuesday night, a Queensland Transport maritime spokesman said.
"A rescue tug has arrived from Port Moresby. A possible refloat could be made tonight," the official told Reuters.
The fully laden Bombay-registered Dakshineshwar was enroute from Hay Point near Mackay to India when it ran aground on a sandbank off Wednesday Island late on Saturday night.
The vessel's oil tanks were intact and there was no sign of hull damage, the official said.
Weather conditions were good and improving with several high tides available if Tuesday night's refloat attempt was unsuccessful, the official said.
